metaDescription: Five copy paste Durga Puja AI photo prompts for Gemini. White red, dhak, pandal night and ghat looks by Bipul Kumar.

faqItems.question: Are these Durga Puja prompts peaceful and family safe?
faqItems.answer: Yes. All five use festive dress and pandal light. There is no violence and no sindoor play in any prompt.

faqItems.question: How are these different from Navratri prompts?
faqItems.answer: These use Kolkata pandal, dhak and ghat settings with white red dress. Navratri looks use home mandir and marigold.
